summary: ST-01 decomposes the section 12 creative pass into three sequential documentation leaves mirroring the request's own step order: WI-01a (steps A-C, world_candidates.md + final_selected_world.md + lore_truth.md), WI-01b (steps D-E, creature_candidates.md), WI-01c (steps F-G, encounter_beats.md + spoiler_map.md plus final spoiler audit). All four parent criteria (AC-cp-world, AC-cp-roster, AC-cp-mapping, AC-cp-spoiler) are preserved verbatim in the children; AC-cp-spoiler is shared by all three with WI-01c named as the single final proof owner. Dependency order a->b->c matches the prescribed sequence (roster needs the selected world; mapping needs roster and world) with no cycles or ancestor/descendant edges. Each leaf is one independently checkable documentation behavior touching at most the private design documentation subsystem and named files (WI-01a additionally the .gitignore entry, which serves the same containment responsibility), with verification limited to named files and structural checks (counts, axes, gates), and handoffs that name the request sections, fixed premises, and reviewer boundaries. The plan artifacts themselves stay generic, satisfying the spoiler boundary AC-cp-spoiler. No source inspection beyond section 12 was needed.
